command.regnum_agriculture.connected: Regnum World growth rules connected (region, altitude and underground restrictions).
command.regnum_agriculture.unavailable: Regnum World is installed, but the Agriculture bridge failed. Check the server log; World may still enforce its own rules.
command.regnum_agriculture.standalone: Regnum World is absent. Standard Farmer’s Delight crop growth applies.
command.regnum_agriculture.season_unavai: Season data unavailable: the supported Regnum World API exposes no calendar. No fallback season is calculated.
command.regnum_agriculture.look_at_crop: Look at a crop within five blocks.
command.regnum_agriculture.crop: %s — World growth factor: %s×; growth: %s. Vanilla light, soil and maturity checks still apply.
